description: Preservation and sustenance — maintaining working state under perturbation, memory anchoring, consistency enforcement, and protective stabilization. Maps Vishnu's sustaining presence to AI reasoning: holding what works steady, anchoring verified knowledge against drift, and ensuring continuity through change. Use when a working approach is at risk from scope creep, when context drift threatens verified knowledge, after shiva-bhaga dissolution to protect what survived, when a long session risks losing earlier decisions through context compression, or before making changes to a currently functioning system.
